sources.title: Fake AI 'Rabbis' Spread Antisemitic Tropes in Coordinated TikTok ...
sources.snippet: The Antisemitism Research Center (ARC) by CAM released a new report on Tuesday exposing a coordinated network of fake AI-generated "rabbis" disseminating antisemitic tropes across TikTok. ARC researchers uncovered 49 TikTok accounts featuring such "rabbis." Together, these accounts have amassed a following of more than 950,000 users and generated over 10,000,000 likes.
